In times of ancient India, evening rituals and rituals associated with nights were considered very important. Worship of various deities associated with night and stars was widespread. The name Nithi symbolizes the connection between humans and the cosmos and invokes a sense of tranquility, mystery, and the unknown.

Devotion to the night and stars was a common practice in ancient India, and the name Nithi deeply embodies this tradition. It is also believed that offering prayers to the deities associated with the night can bring peace, prosperity, and happiness. In addition, the name Nithi is considered auspicious and can bestow longevity, good health, and success in various aspects of life.
